run_claims_sections_valid.name: run_claims_sections_valid
run_claims_sections_valid.value: cardinality("run_claims"."sections") between 1 and 64 and array_position("run_claims"."sections", null) is null and 0 <= all ("run_claims"."sections") and 99 >= all ("run_claims"."sections")

app_config_bounds.name: app_config_bounds
app_config_bounds.value: jsonb_typeof("app_config"."value") <> 'number' or (("app_config"."min_value" is null or ("app_config"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric >= "app_config"."min_value") and ("app_config"."max_value" is null or ("app_config"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric <= "app_config"."max_value"))

plan_requests_note_len.name: plan_requests_note_len
plan_requests_note_len.value: "plan_requests"."note" is null or char_length("plan_requests"."note") between 1 and 1000

runs_insert_own.name: runs_insert_own
runs_insert_own.withCheck: (select auth.uid()) = "runs"."user_id" and (select private.is_anon()) is false and ("runs"."device_id" is null or exists (select 1 from public.devices d where d.id = "runs"."device_id" and d.user_id = (select auth.uid())))

team_invites_email_format.name: team_invites_email_format
team_invites_email_format.value: "team_invites"."email" = lower("team_invites"."email") and char_length("team_invites"."email") between 3 and 254 and position('@' in "team_invites"."email") > 1

public.latest_app_releases.definition: select distinct on (r.platform, r.channel) r.id, r.platform, r.channel, r.version, r.severity, r.reason, r.min_native_version, r.published_at from public.app_releases r order by r.platform, r.channel, r.published_at desc, r.id desc
public.latest_app_releases.name: latest_app_releases
